reviews.question: a rescript from an Imam (unruled): whether the addressee of the rescript is a link

reasons.claim: The only transmitter written is an unnamed group of trustworthy men, a gap link.
The rescript comes from Abu Muhammad, whose words the report relays, so he is the last link; Ishaq is its addressee.
reasons.quote: خرج لإسحاق بن إسماعيل من أبي محمد عليه السلام توقيع

reviews.uncertainty_note: If the owner rules the rescript's addressee a link, Ishaq would stand between the unnamed transmitter and the Imam.

reasons.claim: Rib'i and Fudayl are joined by «و» as co-transmitters from the Imam.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Yahya through Ibn Shihab to Abd al-Rahman.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن بكير، حدثنا الليث، عن عقيل، عن ابن شهاب، قال أخبرني عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

reasons.claim: Abd Allah b. Ka'b heard Ka'b b. Malik, who is the last link; the stored chain omits Abd Allah.
Three links end at the Imam, who tells the whole story; the people in it are not links.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: An unnamed aunt of Umara stands between him and Aisha, a relation link.
reasons.quote: عن عمارة بن عمير، عن عمة، له عن عائشة

reasons.claim: The text is only the end of a saying, with no transmitter.
Zurara heard the Imam, whose words follow; two links.
The long genealogy is one name, the second link, which the stored chain omits.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبوعبد الله عبدالسلام بن محمد بن هارون

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Anas, who relays the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن أنس ابن مالك قال: قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: Ikrima narrated to Uthman al-Shahham from Ibn Abbas, the last link; the blind man led is not a link.
reasons.quote: فانتهيت إلى عكرمة فأنشأ يحدثنا قال حدثني ابن عباس
